name: Synology MCP — Cloud SSH
install:
pip install --user -r bin/apps/desktop/requirements.txt
command -v composer >/dev/null 2>&1 && composer install --no-interaction --working-dir=bin/apps/api || true
command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm install --prefix bin/apps/api || true
bash bin/scripts/ops/clone-synology-mcp.sh /tmp/synology-mcp || true
bash /tmp/synology-mcp/scripts/cloud-agent-ssh-setup.sh 2>/dev/null || bash bin/scripts/ops/setup-cloud-ssh-syno.sh || true
